reason: This candidate pin set was derived from a 279-entry 'undated' list that was produced by a broken local patch, not by upstream main. scripts/build-site.mjs line 241 was changed to `git log --diff-merges=first-parent --diff-filter=A --format=%cI -- <file>` without `--no-patch`, so git emitted patch output, `out[out.length - 1]` picked up a diff line, `new Date(...).toISOString()` threw RangeError, and the bare `catch {}` at line 245 silently left every one of those entries undated. Pristine main reports 3 undated entries (the wwweljf trio); with `--no-patch` it reports 0 and the build completes.
